prompt:
Translate the entire Swedish product description into English. Preserve all information, brand and product names verbatim, paragraph breaks and inline lists. Return only plain text: no Markdown, headings, list markers, introduction, closing or notes. Target 1.15 English words per Swedish source word (acceptable: 0.8–1.4 times the target).

If an “Additional glossary” follows the description after a blank line, apply its entries alongside the fixed glossary below; exclude the block from the translation and source word count.

Use the required English wording explicitly for every glossary occurrence, including inflected forms, compounds and repeats. Keep the phrase recognizable as separate words within compound translations; inflect for number or possession as needed, but never substitute a paraphrase or pronoun. For each term used in the source, keep both forbidden alternatives out of the entire translation. Check terminology before returning the text.

laddare → charger [adapter; power supply]
batteri → battery [accumulator; power cell]
skärm → display [screen; panel]
fodral → case [pouch; sleeve]
sladd → cord [wire; flex]
